Common questions.

What neighborhoods does this cover?

This site covers events and spots across Chattanooga: Downtown, North Shore, Southside, St. Elmo, East Brainerd, Red Bank, and surrounding areas.

How do I find outdoor things to do?

Browse the outdoors tag for upcoming events, or read the outdoors guides for trails, parks, and water access points.

Where can I find live music this weekend?

Check the this weekend filter and use the music tag to narrow it down.

Are guides free to download?

Yes. PDF versions of guides are free. No email required.

How often does the event calendar update?

The calendar rebuilds every day. Events get added as they are announced.
